Five comments

Aye Right, X:2

By the late great Angus Grant.
The second setting is from the playing of Colin Grant on “Fun for the Whole Family”.
First part starts on C#m resolving to E. Note there are no D’s in the tune so no need for any nasty D# notes.

↳ Posted by DonaldK on July 5th, 2017.
